requirements.requirement: Collect a full list of requirements
requirements.what exists: 41 requirements across 8 groups, each with a status and a page that evidences it.

requirements.requirement: Review the repo line by line
requirements.what exists: All 11 existing NFL namespaces inspected; 6 structural irregularities published.
requirements.limitation: Inspection is of files and links, not a re-verification of every peer number.

requirements.requirement: Verify against official, trusted sources; provide links
requirements.what exists: Every table row links to the official page it came from. Source register lists 24 URLs.

requirements.requirement: Flag irregularities for review
requirements.what exists: 19 flagged items, each with a link, published on one page.
requirements.limitation: Flagged items are non-blocking by instruction.

requirements.requirement: Create a GitHub Pages live site with a clean dashboard and category subpages
requirements.what exists: 1 landing page + 11 subpages, one navigation, no JavaScript required.

requirements.requirement: Present all entries and findings in simple, readable tables
requirements.what exists: Every data page is an HTML table with a caption, a row count and a source column.

requirements.requirement: Leave unconfirmed values blank and mark them unverified
requirements.what exists: Blank cells are rendered as a visibly blank pill and counted on the flagged page.

requirements.requirement: Never infer or fill in a value
requirements.what exists: Correlations C6/C8/C9 and all player-prop prices are blank with a stated reason.

requirements.requirement: Originate our own NFL lines
requirements.what exists: 13 Week 10 games carry our own spread, total and win probability, computed from a published model. They are NOT prices.
requirements.limitation: A line without a market to beat cannot be scored as a bet, so it is a forecast, not a price.

requirements.requirement: Research and develop strategies for generating useful signals
requirements.what exists: 5 registered strategies + 2 pre-registered placebos, each with a full result table.
requirements.limitation: Research only: none of them works.

requirements.requirement: Run it as a leaderboard competition with rewards
requirements.what exists: Leaderboard with tiers, 1,000-point pool, 0 points awarded, rollover rule stated.
requirements.limitation: 0 awarded is the honest result; see gates.

requirements.requirement: Cover single bets, parlays and player-prop combos
requirements.what exists: Singles: 5 strategies evaluated. Parlays: leg-independence measured (C1, C2, C7). Player props: dependence measured (C5, phi=0.346).
requirements.limitation: No prop strategy can be scored: there is no archived prop price and no official per-game player log. Flag F-06.

requirements.requirement: Every strategy must pass validation gates
requirements.what exists: 10 pre-registered gates, evaluated with evidence; a strategy cannot appear as a qualifier without clearing every non-blocked gate.

requirements.requirement: Determine correlation values
requirements.what exists: 6 of 9 correlation tests computed with r, n, 95% CI, p and FDR; 3 blank and flagged.
requirements.limitation: Same-game-parlay repricing and injury effects cannot be measured.

requirements.requirement: Remove luck from the equation
requirements.what exists: Walk-forward backtest, week-clustered bootstrap, 2,000-draw permutation null, FDR, season-concentration disclosure, 2 pre-registered placebos.
requirements.limitation: Luck cannot be eliminated; it is bounded and disclosed.

requirements.requirement: Build strategies that are selectively skill based
requirements.what exists: The skill screen is published and it rejects every strategy, including our own model against the closing line.

requirements.requirement: Track injuries
requirements.what exists: 95 official Week 10 designations across 19 clubs, transcribed with the source URL.
requirements.limitation: One week only: the league publishes no historical archive.

requirements.requirement: Know defensive deficiencies: 2nd/3rd/4th string replacing starters
requirements.what exists: Published: the official designation list, and 8 confirmed lineup changes named in official reporting (QB changes at SEA, MIA, BAL, MIN, CLE, AZ).
requirements.limitation: The NFL publishes no depth chart: nfl.com/depth-charts/ returns 404 (re-checked 2026-11-13), and no snap-count feed exists. Any '3rd string' label would be invented. Flag F-05.

requirements.requirement: Same for offences using starters or backups
requirements.what exists: 8 official lineup changes are listed with the club, the player out, the player in, and the article that says so.
requirements.limitation: Confined to changes an official article actually states. No inference from absence.

requirements.requirement: Make suggestions to improve the site and to improve decision making
requirements.what exists: 22 suggestions, each with context, options, evidence, cost, risk, prerequisites and a recommendation.

requirements.requirement: Create a dedicated Suggestions section to review and choose a path
requirements.what exists: suggestions.html is a decision board: an ordered recommended path, and every suggestion labelled Decide-now / Decide-later / Blocked.

requirements.requirement: Clear list of questions, information and answers needed before a decision
requirements.what exists: 20 questions, each with: status, known (sourced), not known, why it blocks, which suggestion would unblock it, and a blank Answer field where no verified answer exists.
requirements.limitation: 9 questions have no verified answer; their Answer field is blank.

requirements.requirement: Suggestions to discover missing information
requirements.what exists: Every suggestion names the question it closes, so the board doubles as a data-acquisition plan.

requirements.requirement: Produce an executive summary
requirements.what exists: One page: bottom line, what was verified, what cannot be sourced, the one real signal, the binding decisions.

requirements.requirement: No manual input from the owner
requirements.what exists: Everything is generated by 5 committed commands; no form, no login, no manual data entry.

requirements.requirement: Verify every table row against an official source, with a link
requirements.what exists: verify.py walks every generated table row and fails the build if any row has no link.
requirements.limitation: It checks that a link exists, not that the value is correct.

requirements.requirement: Coordinate with parallel sessions via COORDINATION.md
requirements.what exists: Claim committed and pushed before any work; scope recorded; peer namespaces untouched.

requirements.requirement: Open a PR, merge without waiting, confirm Pages deploys
requirements.what exists: Recorded in COORDINATION.md with the PR number, merge commit and deploy run.

requirements.requirement: Publish flagged irregularities on a labelled page
requirements.what exists: flagged.html is linked in the main navigation under a ⚑ label and from every page footer.

requirements.requirement: Do not merge a broken site
requirements.what exists: The build fails on a broken local link, an unsourced table row, or a non-reproducible number.

requirements.requirement: Analyse the information we do and do not have
requirements.what exists: A Known / Unknown table of 12 rows states exactly which inputs exist and which do not.

requirements.requirement: Provide links for manual review
requirements.what exists: 24 registered sources, each with what it was used for and when it was read.

requirements.requirement: Treat the competition as leaderboard-style with rewards for top strategies
requirements.what exists: Tier structure, scoring rule, tie-break, and the rollover rule when nothing qualifies.

requirements.requirement: Determine whether a strategy is skill or luck
requirements.what exists: Four independent luck controls plus placebos; all five strategies fail at least one.

requirements.requirement: Show correlation for parlay pricing rather than assuming independence
requirements.what exists: C1, C2, C7 measure the dependence that multiplies legs; the multiplication rule is stated.
requirements.limitation: The repriced SGP price (C8) is unavailable, so the pricing claim stops at dependence.

requirements.requirement: Track lineup changes caused by trades as well as injuries
requirements.what exists: Documented: Brissett trade to BAL, Cousins trade to MIN, Beck promoted at AZ, and the JAX midweek-trade exclusions.
requirements.limitation: Only where official reporting states the consequence.

requirements.requirement: Explain any deficiency in defences specifically
requirements.what exists: Defensive designations are isolated with a position filter, so a defence missing its linebackers or secondary is visible.
requirements.limitation: The size of the effect on the opponent's scoring is not measurable, F-05.

requirements.requirement: Explain the same for offences
requirements.what exists: Offensive designations (QB, OL, WR, RB, TE) are isolated with the same filter.
requirements.limitation: Same limit: no snap counts, no depth chart.

requirements.requirement: Report findings honestly, including null results
requirements.what exists: The headline is a null result: 0 strategies, 0 reward points, model loses to the closing line.

requirements.requirement: Keep the work reproducible
requirements.what exists: 5 commands regenerate every number; CI fails if the derived files change.

requirements.requirement: Do not present research as wagering advice
requirements.what exists: Disclaimer on every page plus the NCPG helpline, sourced from ncpgambling.org.
